title: Simple User Registry
purpose: Smallest useful NPDev scenario for first contact with concepts, invariants, persistence, events, and traceability.
businessStory: A small organization wants to register users while enforcing basic rules and emitting a meaningful business event after success.
walkthrough: Run the sample through the Step 50 one-command trial path.
Call GET /api/flows to confirm the exported flow surface.
POST the create-user payload to the CreateUser flow.
Inspect traces or summaries after the flow succeeds.
expectedOutcomes: Valid data is accepted and persisted.
Trace evidence is created for the flow execution.
The sample demonstrates the minimum useful NPDev business path.
